title: Implement intercepted routes for Stacks block view
description: Refactor the stacks block view from a simple modal to an intercepted route. When clicking a block height on the homepage, it should open in a modal and push the route (allowing deep linking and refresh), but without interrupting the homepage's background state/websocket connections. Closing the modal should return to the homepage flow.

title: Add pagination/load more to homepage burn blocks
description: Implement a "Load More" button at the bottom of the homepage. Clicking it should fetch and display 2 more historical Bitcoin burn blocks and their associated stacks blocks.

title: Detailed Signer View and Debugging
description: Epic for a dedicated signer view. This should allow debugging specific signers by showing a stream of their actions (blocks signed, etc.) and extra details beyond the current overview. To-dos to be filled in later.

title: Truncate stacks blocks in burn blocks on homepage
description: Only show the latest 10 stacks blocks per burn block by default to prevent long lists and UI slowdown. Add a "show more" button to expand and show all blocks. Use Jotai for state management. The limit (10) should be a configurable variable.

title: UI design system alignment improvements
description: Align the UI with the TUI-inspired design system documented in UI-DESIGN.md. Several components don't follow the core principles.
design:
## Changes Required

### 1. Lowercase nav links in header
The UI-DESIGN.md specifies "Lowercase actions" as a core principle. Currently the header nav links use title case ("Extend", "Signers", "Miners", etc.) but should be lowercase ("extend", "signers", "miners", etc.).

**File:** `src/components/header.tsx`

### 2. Remove border radius from containers
The design doc says "Sharp edges - no border-radius on containers and buttons". The burn block currently uses `rounded-lg`.

**File:** `src/components/blocks-v2/burn-block.tsx`

### 3. Card pattern alignment
Update burn block to follow the documented card pattern with proper header styling (border-b, bg-muted/30, etc.)

**File:** `src/components/blocks-v2/burn-block.tsx`
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Nav links are lowercase: "extend", "signers", "miners", "state machines", "blocks"
- [ ] Burn block container has no border-radius
- [ ] Burn block header uses the card pattern from UI-DESIGN.md
close_reason: Implemented all three UI design system alignment changes: lowercase nav links, removed border-radius from burn blocks, and applied card pattern with proper header styling.

title: Automatically expand burn blocks receiving new stacks blocks
description: Update truncation logic to ensure that if a burn block (even if not the most recent one) receives a new approved stacks block, it remains expanded/visible. Check the burn block height of the most recently received/approved stacks block against the burn block height to determine visibility. Use Jotai for state management.

title: Search UI Functionality
description: Generalized epic for adding search capabilities to the app. Currently no search exists. We need to be able to search for blocks, transactions, signers, etc. To-dos to be filled in later.
